The main takeaway from our work is that
CRP fields that are disced and interseeded with legumes (DICRP) provide a valuable habitat for pheasants and other grassland species.
CRP fields should be managed to maintain high levels of vegetative diversity and to reduce litter accumulation to optimize benefits to pheasants.

CRP grasslands are a valuable resource for pheasants and that the benefits of these grasslands to hens and young pheasants are likely greatest during early successional stages of the field's development.
